title: kith-peer: read_at_unix cast to u64 unguarded against negative DB values
description: At kith-peer/src/lib.rs around the receipt handler, read_at_unix (i64 from DB) is cast to u64 via as u64 without a non-negative guard. A negative value (from buggy migration or direct DB write) would wrap to a huge u64 and produce a far-future RFC 3339 timestamp silently. Fix: use read_at_unix.max(0) as u64 or add debug_assert\!(read_at_unix >= 0).
